            You see a warlord sword (Atk:53, Def:38).
Classification: 4 Tier: 0.It can only be wielded properly by knights of level 120 or higher.

It weighs 64.00 oz.
Strong powers flow in this magic sword.

            

        

    

    

    
        Notes

It is one of the rarest items in the game, with only a few existing across all worlds. 

It can be seen below A Sweaty Cyclops in Ab'Dendriel and in Morguthis Room. If you talk to the sweaty cyclops and say warlord sword, he will ask for materials to make it. These materials, however, remain unknown.

    

    
    	Weapon Proficiency

    

1
2

4
5
6
7

+1 defence

+1 defence

+3% mana leech

+3 attack

+5 attack

    

    

    
        History

It used to be considered one of the best swords of Tibia, after Magic Longsword.

It used to have an attack value of 62 and a defense value of 40.

One of the few known examples of this sword was shown in the famous Tibianic Exhibition on Antica, hosted by the Alliance of Free Tibians led by Taghor.

    

    

    
    	Dropped By

    	
This item is not dropped by any creatures.
